reason: Opened the Gamut app, selected the QA-20261123-232059-7nlu agent, confirmed its status was idle, sent "Hello! What is 2+2?", and verified the reply contains 4.
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — the Gamut home page loaded with the sidebar listing agents QA-20261123-232100-wezt and QA-20261123-232059-7nlu, both showing idle.
Clicked the QA-20261123-232059-7nlu agent in the sidebar — the agent page opened at /agents/qa-20261123-232059-7nlu-7dij2zkkjt.
Verified agent status — the header status indicator reads "idle", which is an allowed status.
Typed "Hello! What is 2+2?" into the message box and clicked Send — the browser moved to a new session "Basic Arithmetic Question" and the user message appeared in the chat.
Waited for a response — the reply "Hi there! 2 + 2 = 4." appeared within the wait window, so no timeout occurred.
Verified the response mentions "4" and took a screenshot — the assistant reply "Hi there! 2 + 2 = 4." is visible, and the sidebar shows the session under the agent with the status idle.
